# SuiteScript Reference

> An original, spec-derived reference to NetSuite SuiteScript 2.1 (modules, script types, concepts) plus SuiteScript 1.0 material for reading and converting legacy scripts.

This reference is written for code generators and the engineers who check their output. Start with a script type page to see the entry points a script must export, then use the module pages for exact signatures: every symbol has a `<!-- id: ... -->` marker under its heading, and every callable has a Parameter / Type / Required / Default table followed by returns, errors, governance (usage units) and availability. Concept pages under `topics/` explain behaviour that belongs to no single symbol, such as governance, record modes, deployment, SuiteQL and SDF. Examples are SuiteScript 2.1 AMD `define()` modules. The SuiteScript 1.0 pages exist only to read, convert and minimally repair legacy scripts; write new code in 2.1, using the conversion guide. Where the underlying vendor material appears to be wrong (a misspelt identifier, contradictory text, a copied row), the detail is kept as the source has it and flagged: ` [sic]` right after a suspect name, and a `> [!SOURCE-ERROR]` callout explaining what to verify. Treat flagged details as unconfirmed. Governance described as "not documented; assumed to be free" is a project convention, not a documented figure. Record and field IDs in the generated record pages are search/record IDs; SuiteQL names come from the account's Records Catalog. The generated pages also cover SuiteAnalytics Connect (ODBC) tables, which are not SuiteScript APIs.

- [SuiteScript platform overview](topics/suitescript_overview.md): what SuiteScript is and where scripts run
- [SuiteScript 2.1 overview](topics/ss21_overview.md): the 2.1 language level and its scope

- [SuiteScript Governance and Limits](topics/governance.md): usage units and time limits per script type
- [Global objects and functions](globals.md): define, require, JSON, log, util, Promise and other globals
- [Converting SuiteScript 1.0 to 2.1](conversion/ss1-to-ss21.md): full 1.0 to 2.x mapping table and before/after migration patterns

## Script types

- [BundleInstallationScript](script-types/BundleInstallationScript.md): hooks that run before/after bundle install, update and uninstall
- [ClientScript](script-types/ClientScript.md): browser-side form events such as pageInit, fieldChanged and saveRecord
- [CustomTool](script-types/CustomTool.md): server tools exposed to AI clients through a JSON-RPC schema
- [EventSubscriber](script-types/EventSubscriber.md): handler invoked for subscribed record events
- [MapReduceScript](script-types/MapReduceScript.md): staged bulk processing with getInputData, map, reduce and summarize
- [MassUpdateScript](script-types/MassUpdateScript.md): per-record logic run from a mass update
- [Portlet](script-types/Portlet.md): dashboard portlets rendered by a render entry point
- [Restlet](script-types/Restlet.md): RESTful endpoints for get, put, post and delete
- [ScheduledScript](script-types/ScheduledScript.md): server jobs run on a schedule or on demand
- [SDFInstallationScript](script-types/SDFInstallationScript.md): logic run when an SDF project is deployed
- [Suitelet](script-types/Suitelet.md): server pages and back-end endpoints via onRequest
- [UserEventScript](script-types/UserEventScript.md): beforeLoad, beforeSubmit and afterSubmit record triggers
- [WorkflowActionScript](script-types/WorkflowActionScript.md): custom actions invoked from workflows

## Modules

- [N/action](modules/N_action.md): find and execute record actions
- [N/auth](modules/N_auth.md): change the current user's login email or password
- [N/cache](modules/N_cache.md): short-term server-side caching of string values
- [N/certificateControl](modules/N_certificateControl.md): manage certificates stored in the account
- [N/commerce/recordView](modules/N_commerce_recordView.md): fast read-only item and website data for web stores

- [N/config](modules/N_config.md): load and update configuration pages
- [N/crypto](modules/N_crypto.md): hashing, HMAC and symmetric encryption with stored secrets
- [N/crypto/certificate](modules/N_crypto_certificate.md): sign and verify data and XML with certificates

- [N/currency](modules/N_currency.md): currency exchange rates
- [N/currentRecord](modules/N_currentRecord.md): the record currently open in the browser
- [N/dataset](modules/N_dataset.md): SuiteAnalytics datasets
- [N/datasetLink](modules/N_datasetLink.md): link two datasets for workbooks
- [N/documentCapture](modules/N_documentCapture.md): extract text, fields and tables from documents
- [N/email](modules/N_email.md): send email, bulk email and campaign events
- [N/encode](modules/N_encode.md): convert strings between encodings
- [N/error](modules/N_error.md): create and throw SuiteScript errors; error type catalogue
- [N/file](modules/N_file.md): create, load, read and save File Cabinet files
- [N/format](modules/N_format.md): parse and format dates, times and numbers
- [N/format/i18n](modules/N_format_i18n.md): locale-aware number, currency and phone formatting
- [N/http](modules/N_http.md): HTTP calls and server request/response objects
- [N/https](modules/N_https.md): HTTPS calls, secure strings and RESTlet/Suitelet requests
- [N/https/clientCertificate](modules/N_https_clientCertificate.md): HTTPS calls authenticated with a client certificate
- [N/keyControl](modules/N_keyControl.md): manage keys stored in the account
- [N/llm](modules/N_llm.md): generative AI text, chat, tools, embeddings and reranking
- [N/log](modules/N_log.md): write execution log entries
- [N/machineTranslation](modules/N_machineTranslation.md): machine translation of text
- [N/manufacturing/productionCharges](modules/N_manufacturing_productionCharges.md): update manufacturing production charges
- [N/pgp](modules/N_pgp.md): PGP encryption, decryption, signing and verification
- [N/piremoval](modules/N_piremoval.md): remove personal information from records
- [N/plugin](modules/N_plugin.md): load custom plug-in implementations
- [N/portlet](modules/N_portlet.md): refresh and resize portlets
- [N/query](modules/N_query.md): query definitions, conditions, paging and SuiteQL
- [N/record](modules/N_record.md): create, load, edit, transform, attach and save records
- [N/recordContext](modules/N_recordContext.md): record context such as localization
- [N/redirect](modules/N_redirect.md): redirect the browser to records, Suitelets, searches and URLs
- [N/render](modules/N_render.md): render PDFs and HTML from templates; email merge
- [N/runtime](modules/N_runtime.md): current script, user, session and account information
- [N/scriptTypes/restlet](modules/N_scriptTypes_restlet.md): build custom RESTlet responses
- [N/search](modules/N_search.md): saved and ad hoc searches, paging and field lookups
- [N/sftp](modules/N_sftp.md): SFTP connections, upload and download
- [N/sso](modules/N_sso.md): single sign-on module and its status
- [N/suiteAppInfo](modules/N_suiteAppInfo.md): installed SuiteApps and bundles
- [N/task](modules/N_task.md): submit and monitor scheduled, map/reduce, CSV, search and query tasks
- [N/task/accounting/recognition](modules/N_task_accounting_recognition.md): merge revenue arrangements and elements
- [N/transaction](modules/N_transaction.md): void transactions
- [N/translation](modules/N_translation.md): translation collection strings

## Generated reference tables

- [Generated reference index](gen/index.md): entry point to the mechanically generated tables
- [Records](gen/records/index.md): record types with fields, sublists, search filters, columns, joins and transforms
- [SuiteAnalytics Connect tables](gen/connect/index.md): ODBC/JDBC tables, columns and keys (not SuiteScript APIs)
- [Catalogs](gen/catalogs/index.md): ID lists such as permissions, features, preferences, SDF value lists and SuiteQL functions
